QuestInfo.name: Off to the Alcadno Lab
QuestInfo.0: You saved everyone that was locked up in the Zenumist Laboratory. Talk to #p9390370#, she looks like she has more to talk about.
QuestInfo.1: #p9390363# and #p9390362# went ahead to the Alcadno Laboratory and #p9390370# is worried about them. She wants you to make sure they're okay and let them know that she'll be waiting for them in #m261000000#. Head to the Alcadno Laboratory and speak to #p9390362#.
QuestInfo.2: You passed along #p9390370#'s message to #p9390362#. #p9390362# found a bunch of mechanical monsters at the Alacadno Laboratory, but needs a key to get in. Hunt some monsters... one of them is bound to have the key on them.
